# Land a Job

> A local-first, agent-native job-search pipeline: target companies → JD matching → resume tailoring → applications → follow-ups → interviews → offer negotiation.
> All data lives in a local SQLite file and the app makes zero model calls; AI capability comes from skills the user installs, running inside their own agent and reading/writing local data over MCP.

## Install (performed by an agent)

- [Install guide (for agents)](https://dada-liu.github.io/land-a-job/agent-install.md): environment check, clone, build, start the server, install skills, register MCP, verify — plus failure handling and hard rules.
- [安装说明（中文，给 Agent）](https://dada-liu.github.io/land-a-job/agent-install.zh-CN.md)

## Key constraints

- The app calls no model and stores no API key; there are no `generate_*` tools in MCP.
- There is exactly one way to write: the local Fastify service.
- AI output must be persisted with `provenance: { skill, skillVersion }`.
- Submitting an application requires `confirm: true`; in browser-assisted applying the final click always belongs to the user.
